protocol.framing: one UTF-8 JSON object per line

writfold.trial/1.method_schemas: trial-methods.json is the complete methods advertisement of a session that negotiated this capability; methods.json is the advertisement without it.

cli_only.rule: Not registered: each is Method not found (-32601) in every session state. The operator key decides an approval and an agent session must not approve its own edit; apply and recover stay with the operator's CLI too.

writfold.trial/1.state: Fixed at server startup by `writfold serve --state DIR` or WRITFOLD_STATE; never a request parameter. Without it, initialize requesting writfold.trial/1 refuses as an unsupported capability.
writfold.trial/1.parameters: Closed objects; unknown, missing or mistyped fields are Invalid params (-32602). repo, recipe, report, tuft, weft, weft_bin are absolute host paths; file is a plain repository-relative path; start/end/limit/context_lines are u64 integer tokens, start/end selecting bytes [start, end). trial/run takes weft and weft_bin together or neither.
refusal_order: method lookup (approve/apply/recover and any unregistered name: -32601)
session state (before initialize or after shutdown: -32002)
negotiation (session did not negotiate writfold.trial/1: -32000 malformed, unsupported requested capability)
the same application function as the CLI
writfold.trial/1.results: Shutdown-shaped envelope: exit_code 0, complete true, generation, session and the method payload. trial/show's, trial/run's and trial/evidence-show's text and trial/evidence-list's rows and trailer are exactly the CLI's output; trial/prepare and trial/run do not report the worktree path. trial/run stops at a prepared edit: it never approves or applies.
writfold.trial/1.refusals: Application refusals are -32000 Operation failed with category not-found/E101, malformed/E102, conflict/E104 (ledger step refused or head moved), incomplete/E105 (Git/IO/ledger failure, or result over the frame budget) or permission/E106, chosen by error type. data.message is exactly the text the CLI prints after `writfold: `.
writfold.trial/1.outcomes: rejected: trial/show, trial/evidence-list, trial/evidence-show, or a refusal decided before any write. unknown (exit_code null): trial/retain, trial/prepare or trial/run failed after it may have written (a refused trial/run is always unknown: an earlier step may have retained evidence); observe with trial/show, trial/evidence-list or the CLI before retrying.
writfold.trial/1.budget: A result that would exceed max_response_bytes refuses with incomplete/E105; it is never truncated. For prepare/run/retain the refusal names the run or binding and reports outcome unknown; for evidence-list it asks for a narrower path, commit or limit.
writfold.trial/1.latency: Agent-facing budget: p95 at most 1 s per call and at most 250 ms for trial/show, trial/evidence-list and trial/evidence-show; hard ceiling 5 s. trial/run's Weft step runs the client-named binary, whose own time (up to its 30 s step limit) is not bounded by this budget.
writfold.trial/1.revision: Revision 2 of this capability (10 November 2026) adds trial/run, trial/evidence-list and trial/evidence-show; trial/show, trial/retain and trial/prepare and every refusal are unchanged, so a client of the first revision keeps working. Clients pin the contract digest, which changes.

identity.instance: Ephemeral entropy-backed transport-process label, not a KB or durable owner.
identity.incarnation: Independent ephemeral session label, not a grant.
identity.generation: Unsigned 64-bit invocation counter; first admitted envelope is 1, every valid envelope including notifications/refusals consumes one, malformed JSON/envelopes consume none. Exhaustion refuses and closes; no wrap/reuse. Not CitationTableGeneration.
identity.integer_request_ids: Preserve arbitrary-precision signed integer lexical tokens. Fraction/exponent tokens are invalid even when mathematically integral. Parsed integer -0 normalizes to 0. Strings and explicit null remain distinct; missing id is a notification only after envelope admission.
identity.durable_citations: The included writfold-citation/1 descriptor schema names candidate immutable material only; it does not expose a corpus citation reader, acquire corpus bytes, authenticate a release, or grant access. trial/retain and trial/run bind exact bytes in the cooperating trial state only; trial/evidence-list and trial/evidence-show read back and verify those bytes.

precedence: enforce session state and method-specific schema/capability precedence
prepare complete bounded reply unless notification
write/flush prepared bytes; fatal IO closes the invocation
initialize_order: admit supported capability spellings and current capability set (writfold.trial/1 only with a startup-configured trial state)
commit initialized (and the negotiated capability set)
shutdown_order: flush and close without reading another request
lifecycle.eof: A final non-newline frame is evaluated; EOF then exits 0. Shutdown closes immediately, including shutdown notifications.
lifecycle.oversized: Drain through LF/EOF with bounded memory, report Invalid Request with null id/generation, then continue if input remains.
lifecycle.encoding_failure: Terminate without emitting a partial reply, truncating or substituting the ID; no successful lifecycle change precedes successful complete encoding.
lifecycle.notifications: Well-formed notifications execute lifecycle; method/param/state failures emit nothing. A trial method sent as a notification is not run, because it could not report its outcome. Invalid JSON/envelopes still receive errors.
lifecycle.effects: Without writfold.trial/1 no corpus, retained-release, grounding, publication, ledger or effect service exists and no child process is launched. With it, trial/retain, trial/prepare and trial/run write the configured trial state and launch the state's admitted Git executable exactly as the CLI does; trial/run with weft also runs the client-named Weft binary by absolute path. Nothing writes the user's checkout, and no approval, apply or recovery is reachable.

validation.schema_limit: JSON Schema validates shapes but cannot distinguish integer lexical forms or prove cross-field/order/content/authenticity conditions. Implement the declared byte rules and run the vectors.
citation_conditions: selector first <= last; integer u64 tokens only
Git commit/blob algorithm and full lowercase width match
literal relative UTF-8 path: no empty, dot, parent or NUL components
capture_digest is raw whole-capture SHA256 and becomes semantic ContentId, not native Git blob ID
bind requires exact selected preimage length and raw SHA256; full provenance/access/retention remain external host obligations
validation.stream_safety: No raw malformed values or parser diagnostics are reflected in error details. Correlation IDs are preserved and JSON-escaped, not normalized into another namespace.

blocked_requirements: citation, assessment, finite-collection and frozen read-closure services
